_: Kill-check for asc-09wx.9: the commit size signal (`commit-size.ts`), the `derived:git` store source, and `asc ingest git`. M1-M4 are the four places the threshold EV-61 measured can be computed a near copy of itself: flagging at the threshold rather than above it, a different percentile, a commit counting toward its own threshold, and an off-by-one in the minimum. M5 drops the graded flag on the way into the entry. M6 and M7 are the two copies of the source list the store keeps beside `ENTRY_SOURCES`: the SQL CHECK, and the row mapping that used to read every unknown source as 'self'. M8 swaps the re-run outcomes, which is the idempotency claim. Killers were found by planting each mutant and reading the failing test names off vitest's JSON reporter. Not covered here: `--no-renames` in `COMMIT_LOG_ARGS`, which the fidelity replay against EV-63's log checks (asc-09wx.9 notes) and no test in this repository does.
